speaker.name: Data Dave
speaker.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

output.objection: I did not just want the trigger to fire automatically, I want the schema validation and lineage checks to pass before that trigger is even allowed to run. You cannot skip the data quality gate just to save a few minutes of latency.
output.correction: You are treating this as a simple scheduling task, but I am talking about the integrity of the feature store inputs. The automation must include a hard stop if the incoming scan lines fail my quality thresholds, not just a blind start command.
